2607.20019.title: EvoDRC: A Self-Evolving Agentic Framework for Automated DRC Violation Repair
2607.20019.paper_summary: Design rule check (DRC) closure remains a major bottleneck in advanced-node physical design. Although detailed routers are rule-aware, residual design rule violations (DRVs) often require manual engineering change order iterations. Automating this process is challenging because repairs must account for complex geometric interactions, preserve circuit connectivity, and avoid introducing new violations. We present EvoDRC, a skill-evolution framework for agentic block-level DRC repair. EvoDRC initializes layer-specific repair skills using knowledge distilled from an unrelated reference design and continuously evolves these skills using traceable repair experience collected from the target design. EvoDRC decomposes the layout into bounded repair regions and assigns an LLM repair agent to each region. Local DRC analysis, connectivity-checking, and impact-preview tools provide feedback on proposed modifications. Repair operations and their resulting DRV changes are stored in a knowledge database and used to evolve the repair skills. Experiments on seven block-level designs from the DAC26 DRC Benchmark show that EvoDRC achieves a 73.5\% overall reduction compared to the reported baseline.
2607.20019.paper_summary_zh: 設計規則檢查（DRC）閉合仍然是先進節點物理設計中的主要瓶頸。雖然詳細路由器是規則感知的，但殘餘的設計規則違規（DRV）通常需要手動工程變更訂單的迭代。自動化這一過程具有挑戰性，因為修復必須考慮複雜的幾何互動，保持電路連通性，並避免引入新的違規。 我們提出了EvoDRC，一個針對區塊級DRC修復的技能演進框架。EvoDRC使用從無關參考設計中提煉的知識初始化層特定的修復技能，並利用從目標設計中收集的可追溯修復經驗不斷演進這些技能。EvoDRC將佈局分解為有限的修復區域，並為每個區域分配一個LLM修復代理。當地DRC分析、連通性檢查和影響預覽工具提供對提議修改的反饋。修復操作及其導致的DRV變化被存儲在知識數據庫中，並用於演進修復技能。對DAC26 DRC基準中的七個區塊級設計的實驗表明，與報告的基線相比，EvoDRC實現了73.5\%的整體減少。
